The '''Iokath system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. At some point before the end of [[Manderon Period|Manderon period]], an outside [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] chose the system to implement [[Project Iokath]]. Every orbital body in the system, down to the last asteroid, was demolished and salvaged for core elements to create a massive self-sustaining ecosphere that completely engulfed its [[Iokath system's star|star]], using 100% of its energy output. The massive habitat was named [[Iokath]] and since once completed it allowed no light from its star outside, the entire system became undetectable to the rest of the galaxy.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Iokath}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Iokath system appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''. Iokath itself is a type of construct known in fiction as a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dyson_sphere Dyson sphere], though this exact term is not used in ''Star Wars''.
